title: Canonical documents, shared definitions (version 1)
description: Building blocks shared by the order, order response, despatch advice and invoice schemas. Not a document by itself.

decimal.title: Decimal
decimal.description: A decimal number written as text, so that no digit is lost: no exponent, no thousands separator, a point as decimal mark. Compare values as numbers: 5.5 and 5.50 are the same rate.

unsignedDecimal.title: UnsignedDecimal
unsignedDecimal.description: A decimal that cannot be negative: a price, a rate, the amount of a discount or a charge.

documentFunction.title: DocumentFunction
documentFunction.description: Whether a document is the first one, replaces an earlier one with the same number or cancels it. Absent means original.

gln.title: Gln
gln.description: Global Location Number, 13 digits. The check digit is verified by the validator, not by this schema.

gtin.title: Gtin
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits.

unit.title: UnitCode
unit.description: Unit of measure as a short upper-case code (UN/ECE Recommendation 20, for example PCE). The code list is not part of this schema.

moment.title: Moment
moment.description: A date, or a date and time with a UTC offset (RFC 3339). A mapping adds the offset of the partner when the message has none.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A document number, item number or other reference chosen by a partner.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free text, one entry per note.

lineNumber.title: LineNumber
lineNumber.description: Position of a line in its document, starting at 1.

party.title: Party
party.description: A company or a location. The GLN is the usual key; other identifiers (VAT number, SIRET) go in `identifiers`.

scheme.description: Lower case name of the numbering scheme, for example vat or siret.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: A pointer to another document, a contract or any other reference carried by the message. `label` says what an `other` reference is.

product.title: Product
product.description: Identifies an item by at least one of its GTIN, the supplier's number, the buyer's number or its description.

unitPrice.title: UnitPrice
unitPrice.description: Net price of `basisQuantity` units (one unit when absent), in the currency of the document.

taxCategory.title: TaxCategory
taxCategory.description: How a line is taxed. The rate tells apart the standard, reduced and other non-zero rates.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: The tax category and its rate in percent, for example 20 or 5.5.

adjustment.title: Adjustment
adjustment.description: A discount (allowance) or an extra cost (charge) on a line or on the whole document. The amount is positive.

package.title: Package
package.description: A logistic unit, with the lines it holds and the packages inside it (a pallet holding cartons).

items.title: PackageContent
items.description: A quantity of the despatch line `lineNumber` held by the package.
